title: Ten years, ii
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (Ten Years Under the Table · deepening)
logline: Tuesday. The beach walk, the one from 2000, at 2009's speed. The strip draws the old route with the new pace: four panels, the same distance the first strip did in one.

panels.composition: The beach, November. WOOD and BARNABY, ten, at the bluff stairs' foot. The drift log far off.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a November beach with a thin man and an old dog at the foot of bluff stairs, a drift log far along the sand

panels.composition: A third of the way. The dog sitting. Wood waiting, looking at the water like that's why he stopped.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man standing looking at the sea while an old dog sits on the sand behind him, no words

panels.composition: Two thirds. The dog walking again. Wood a step behind, matching him.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, an old dog walking slowly along a beach with a thin man one step behind matching its pace, no words

panels.composition: The log. The dog against it. Wood sitting on it. The water. Panel one of Drift Wood #9, the Rain, took this whole walk in one panel in 1998. The strip took four.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man sitting on a bleached drift log with an old dog leaning against it, the sea beyond, no words
image.notes: Four panels for the 1998 one-panel walk. The reader can compare.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The 1998 walk at 2009's speed. Four panels for one.
